# EOLOS DESIGN LAB · International (eoloslab.com)

> EOLOS DESIGN LAB is a commercial design studio. Three local studios (Madrid, Stockholm,
> Athens) serve their home markets, and eoloslab.com is the international studio, working with
> clients across every border. It offers six services: interior and spatial design, brand
> identity and strategy, web design and build, creative direction, visualization, and an
> integrated project that designs space, brand and web together on one brief. A senior partner
> leads every project, with no account layer. How far each engagement goes depends on scope.
> Part of the WOLFBLANC group.

## Services
- Interior & Spatial Design: https://eoloslab.com/services/interior-design
- Brand Identity & Strategy: https://eoloslab.com/services/brand-identity
